# Review

**Scope reviewed:** contained image preparation (`contained-image.ts`), contained command executor (`contained-command.ts`, `contained-docker.ts`), contained test registration/validation (`graph-contained-tests.ts`), broker (`graph-action-broker.ts`), verification store/join (`graph-verification-store.ts`, `graph-verification-join.ts`), host composition (`graph-delivery.ts`, `graph-verification.ts`), plus supplied test diffs and deterministic results.

**Binding:** Host-built identity (scope/run/generation/effectKey/invocation/candidateRevision/artifactDigest/command/image receipt) is hashed into `bindingRef`, persisted as `binding.json` before create, and folded into `specDigest`, which is re-verified against launch records, container labels, and stop receipts. `validateContainedTestEvidence` recomputes the full chain, so generation/invocation/container/image substitution fails transitively. The substitution test (candidate/image/generation/invocation/containerId edits all rejected) corroborates. No worker/model identity is consumed; reviewer/contained receipts are host-constructed.

**Isolation:** Build context contains only a host-generated `FROM <pinned digest>` / `COPY candidate/` / `WORKDIR` Dockerfile; candidate Dockerfiles are inert data (test-proven), `pull:false`, `networkmode:none`, base image inspected for ONBUILD/volumes pre-build, built image re-inspected post-build. Runtime: network none, no mounts, readonly rootfs, tmpfs-only /tmp, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, non-root, restart=no, resource limits, and full post-create inspect against the expected config before start.

**Settlement:** Exit codes are interpreted only after a verified physical stop (204 DELETE + subsequent 404 + durable receipt); `stopped===true` is mandatory in envelope validation. Registered fail codes yield `confirmed` with `passed=false`; unregistered codes/cancellation yield non-retryable trusted failures; lost DELETE ACK → unknown, admission retained, replay returns unknown (test-proven). Authorization is synchronous-only and re-checked at every phase.

**Join:** Latest-ledger recomputation with binding/artifact/evidence revalidation, snapshot-digest race check, correct handling of confirmed pass (0/42), confirmed fail (passed=false), structured failure, and unknown branches; shell command path preserved alongside contained path.

**Journal:** Atomic temp+fsync+link(no-replace)+dir-fsync publication; binding before create, launch before start, stop receipt before release; catch-all `confirmStopped` fails closed.

No blocking findings; verdict approved.

review.markdown:
# Review

All five criteria pass on the supplied bounded evidence. Binding: host-constructed identity (scope/run/generation/effectKey/invocation/candidate/artifact/command/image) is hashed into bindingRef, persisted before create, folded into specDigest, and re-verified against launch, container inspect, and stop receipts; the substitution test confirms cross-candidate/image/generation/invocation/container tampering is rejected. Isolation: build executes only host FROM/COPY/WORKDIR with candidate bytes as inert data, pull=false, network=none, base and built images inspected for ONBUILD/volumes; runtime has no mounts, network none, readonly rootfs, cap-drop ALL, non-root, and full config re-inspection before start. Settlement: exit codes are read only after verified physical removal (204+404+durable receipt); valid fail codes settle confirmed passed=false, unregistered codes/cancellation become non-retryable trusted failures, lost DELETE ACK yields unknown with admission retained and replay sealed. Join: latest-ledger recomputation with digest-pinned race check routes pass/fail/unknown correctly and preserves the shell command path. Journal: atomic no-replace durable writes ordered binding->create->launch->start->stop receipt; confirmStopped fails closed. No blocking findings.

judgments.summary: Candidate bytes, pinned image, ledger effect, generation, invocation and container ID are linked via host-computed bindingRef/specDigest and receipt chains; worker/model identity is never an input; substitution tests reject tampering.

Image preparation runs only host-generated FROM/COPY/WORKDIR with candidate files as data, no pull/network, base+built image ONBUILD/volume inspection; execution keeps network none, no mounts, readonly rootfs, dropped caps, non-root user and verified container config.

Business pass/fail is derived from exit codes only after verified physical stop; registered fail codes give confirmed passed=false; ambiguity (lost DELETE ACK) retains admission and seals replay; synchronous authorization is rechecked throughout.

Join recomputes from the latest ledger with binding/artifact/evidence validation and snapshot race detection; normal and allowlisted-nonzero exits reach complete join/repair/stop decisions; contained and shell paths both supported.

Exact identity is durably written (atomic no-replace link + fsync) before create, launch before start, stop receipt after confirmed removal; lost stop acknowledgement never authorizes release or replay.

findings.message: Base-image safety inspection and build are separate daemon calls, so a retag between them is only detectable via the trusted daemon; this is explicitly inside the stated trust boundary (daemon/base image trusted) and out of scope.
Container output is bounded (tail=100 frames, 16KiB slice) and evidence store marks previews as lossy with full-stream hash/length; acceptable per documented diagnostic-only capture semantics.
